notes: Administrative-department entities (kind: state_department) for West Bengal, Assam and Sikkim, referencing existing minister/CM/Chief-Secretary position ids from states-wb-as-sk.json (not redefined here). West Bengal: 54 departments sourced directly from the official department index at wb.gov.in (government-departments-page.aspx), each with its own officialUrl; headPositionId matched by substring against each minister's 'Portfolio:' note (4 fell back to the Chief Minister at confidence=medium because their names weren't literally present in any minister's portfolio text: Correctional Administration, Disaster Management and Civil Defence, Paschimanchal Unnayan Affairs, Planning and Statistics — plausible since the CM holds 'all departments not allotted to other ministers', but unconfirmed by an explicit source). Assam: 51 departments derived from the Second Sarma ministry's official portfolio allocation as reported by Wikipedia/press (assam.gov.in's own /departments-list is a client-rendered page that returned almost no content to a static fetch within this session's tool budget, so no per-department officialUrl could be sourced; confidence=medium throughout). Sikkim: 40 departments sourced directly from the official department index at sikkim.gov.in (nav 'Departments' menu), each with its own officialUrl; 13 fell back to the Chief Minister (Home, Finance, Planning & Development, Personnel, Power, Excise, Land Revenue & Disaster Management, Transport, Information & Public Relations, Information Technology, Skill Development, DESME, Election) which matches the residual after all 11 ministers' stated portfolios are accounted for. SECRETARIES: none were added in this pass. This session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200, shared across the parallel research run) before administrative-secretary research could start, and SCHEMA.md's instruction is to omit rather than guess a posting — filling st-<code>-pos-secretary-<dept-slug> needs a follow-up pass against each state's 2025-2026 IAS posting/transfer-order list (e.g. WB Personnel & AR Dept, Assam DoP&AR, Sikkim DoP orders) with a fresh search budget. Relations: 'heads' minister/CM -> department for every department, plus 'oversees' Chief Secretary -> department for every department (all three states' chief-secretary position ids exist in the base file).
